ov: Large, often hairy spiders, over a thousand species in almost 200 genera. Most live in burrows and many New World species defend themselves by flicking irritating hairs.

why.dg: Bites from New World tarantulas usually cause only local pain, but allergic reactions can be serious, and the hairs can damage eyes.
why.et: Tarantulas are eaten as a delicacy in places such as Venezuela and Cambodia, roasted over a fire to remove the bristles.
why.p: Increasingly popular as pets, though many New World species flick hairs that irritate skin.

rg: The Americas, Africa and Asia, in savanna, grassland, rainforest, desert, scrub, mountains and cloud forest.
df: Prey that it liquefies with digestive juices and sucks up.
fx: Males die soon after maturing, so females, which can live 30 to 40 years, are preferred as pets.
